data.one_liner: A scrollable list view with a vertical alphabet index for quick jumping.
data.what_it_does: Provides a scrollable list view widget combined with a dynamic vertical alphabet index list on the side. Users can drag or tap letters on the index to automatically scroll to the first item starting with that letter.
use_when: You need to display a long alphabetically ordered list, such as contacts or a country list.
You want users to be able to jump to specific sections of a list quickly using an alphabet sidebar.
avoid_when: Your list items do not have alphabetical ordering or textual identifiers.
You require complex grid layouts rather than a standard vertical list.
strengths: Supports custom overlay widgets to display the currently selected letter.
Allows alignment of the alphabet list on either the left or the right side.
Responsive across all screen sizes and platforms supported by Flutter.
weaknesses: No documentable advanced customization beyond standard parameters and overlay widgets.
